name: Ron Burgundy
look: A film still of Will Ferrell as Ron Burgundy, a mustached anchorman in a brown suit and striped tie, sitting at a news desk holding papers and staring into the camera. Behind him is a blue backdrop repeating the Channel 4 News Team logo.
use: Ron delivers the caption as breaking news with total anchorman confidence. Captions are absurd headlines, smug announcements or riffs on his famous lines like 'I'm kind of a big deal' and 'Stay classy'.
slots: top caption: the setup or headline
bottom caption: the punchline or sign-off
examples: Local man finally replies to an email from three weeks ago
I don't know how to put this
But I'm kind of a big deal at trivia night
